experiment: Two-scene six-step SJTU fixed novel-view target-anchor adapter applied to official DD camera encoder+DiT LoRA, native inference on real case15 C 17-frame hardcase. Same effective media, Stage2 endpoint, prompt and initial noise as official baseline; checkpoint only changed.
holistic_visual_review: Reviewed dense source/official/six-step native frames f0,2,...,16 and every six-step frame f0..16. The source right arm sweeps across the torso and the body changes pose; both generated versions keep the right arm near its initial downward/back position, body motion is compressed, and person plus background fade progressively after the middle. Six-step output has no material visible recovery and may have slightly worse late contrast.
caveat: Two fixed-view RGB-D training scenes and six steps; scene-disjoint held-out Skipping Rope already failed to recover limb motion. Inspect all 17 real hardcase frames before judging.
